# Copilot Instructions

<!-- Use this file to provide workspace-specific custom instructions to Copilot. For more details, visit https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-customization#_use-a-githubcopilotinstructionsmd-file -->

This is a Flutter todo application project. When generating code:

## Project Structure
- Use proper Flutter/Dart conventions and best practices
- Follow the established folder structure: lib/models, lib/services, lib/widgets, lib/screens
- Use StatefulWidget for components that need state management
- Implement proper error handling and null safety

## Key Features to Maintain
- Dark/Light theme support with system preference detection
- Local data persistence using shared_preferences or hive
- Task management with categories, priorities, and due dates
- Search and filtering capabilities
- Statistics and productivity tracking
- Responsive design for multiple screen sizes

## Code Style
- Use descriptive variable and function names
- Add proper documentation and comments
- Follow Flutter's material design principles
- Implement proper widget composition and reusability
- Use const constructors where possible for performance

## Dependencies
- Prefer well-maintained, popular packages
- Use flutter_riverpod or provider for state management
- Use shared_preferences for simple data persistence
- Use material design components and animations
